Preconditions: User is logged in with permission to access Leave
Test Steps: 1. Open the Leave module. 2. Review the available leave pages and navigation options.
Expected Result: The Leave module opens successfully and available leave pages are accessible.

Preconditions: User is on an available leave-record page
Test Steps: 1. Review the leave records. 2. Review the displayed columns and record information.
Expected Result: Leave records and relevant information are displayed clearly without unexpected errors.

Test Scenario: Search leave records with valid criteria
Preconditions: User is on a leave-record page and a known leave record exists
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid criteria for a known leave record. 2. Select Search.
Test Data: Known employee, date, or leave-status criteria

Test Scenario: Search leave records with invalid criteria
Preconditions: User is on a leave-record page
Test Steps: 1. Enter criteria that do not match any leave record. 2. Select Search.
Expected Result: The system displays no matching records or an equivalent empty-result response.

Preconditions: User is on a leave-record page with available filters
Test Steps: 1. Select an available leave filter. 2. Provide valid filter criteria. 3. Select Search.
Test Data: Valid leave type, status, employee, or date criteria
Expected Result: The leave list displays records matching the selected criteria.

Preconditions: User is on a leave-record page with search or filter criteria applied
Test Steps: 1. Enter leave search or filter criteria. 2. Select Reset.
Expected Result: The search and filter fields are cleared and the default leave list is restored.

Test Scenario: Submit a leave request with valid data where permitted
Preconditions: User is logged in and the leave-request workflow is available
Test Steps: 1. Open the leave-request page. 2. Enter valid leave information. 3. Submit the request.
Test Data: Valid leave type, available date range, and optional comments
Expected Result: The leave request is submitted successfully and an appropriate confirmation or status is displayed.

Test Scenario: Submit a leave request with missing mandatory data
Preconditions: User is on the leave-request page
Test Steps: 1. Leave one or more mandatory fields empty. 2. Submit the request.
Expected Result: The request is not submitted and required-field validation is displayed for the missing fields.

Test Scenario: Submit a leave request with invalid data
Preconditions: User is on the leave-request page
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid data in a field that has validation rules. 2. Submit the request.
Expected Result: The invalid data is rejected or an appropriate validation message is displayed.

Preconditions: User is on the leave-request page
Test Steps: 1. Enter an invalid date or select an end date earlier than the start date. 2. Submit the request.
Test Data: End date earlier than start date or invalid date value
Expected Result: The date validation prevents submission and displays an appropriate validation message.

Test Scenario: Verify leave status or workflow behavior
Preconditions: A leave request exists or the available workflow can be opened
Test Steps: 1. Open an available leave request or leave-status page. 2. Review available status and actions. 3. Perform an allowed workflow action where applicable.
Test Data: Existing leave request and available workflow action
Expected Result: Leave statuses and available actions behave as expected for the demo user.

Preconditions: User is on an available leave form or leave action page
Test Steps: 1. Enter or change leave information. 2. Select Cancel or navigate away without submitting. 3. Reopen the form if applicable.
Expected Result: The leave action is canceled and unsaved information is not persisted.

Preconditions: A leave request or leave update has been saved successfully
Test Steps: 1. Navigate away from the leave record. 2. Refresh or reopen the relevant leave page. 3. Search for or review the saved record.
Expected Result: The saved leave information remains available and unchanged after navigation or refresh.
